name: EU-Startups

sources.title: Submit listing view (per launchpointzero.com directory profile)
Third-party profile noting free submission and European focus
Third-party profile describing account + free submission flow

requirements: European startup focus — the directory is for companies based in / operating in Europe
A working product/company site with a name, URL, short description and logo
Site blocks automated access (Cloudflare-style protection) — expect an interactive browser session
preparation: Account credentials for eu-startups.com (account creation is part of the flow per third-party guides)
Startup name, website URL, short description, logo image
workflow: Create an account / log in on eu-startups.com
Fill in the listing form: name, URL, description, logo, category
Submit and wait for manual review
Verify the listing appears in the EU-Startups Database once approved
watchFor: The directory page 403s to non-browser fetchers — do not assume the site is down
Free listings are hand-reviewed; third-party sources report days-to-weeks delay
Eligibility is European startups — non-EU companies have been reported rejected
Renamed from 'directory' to 'Startup Database'; older submit links may redirect
countsAsLive: The startup's profile page is publicly visible in the EU-Startups Database under /directory/ and searchable/browsable by category
unknowns: Exact list of form fields on the current submit flow
Whether free listings are dofollow (third-party sources claim dofollow; not verified on a live listing)
Whether paid/sponsored tiers exist alongside the free listing
